metadata.description: Royalust Big Island Retreat Compliance Checklist

categories.title: Safe Operating Mode
categories.description: Current low-risk operations framework for day-use educational workshops

items.title: Run day-use, private educational workshops under PMA
items.description: Frame as educational retreats/sustainability workshops - fits Ag District uses

items.title: Frame activities as educational retreats and sustainability workshops
items.description: Ensure all activities align with Agricultural District permitted uses

items.title: Plan for future overnight operations
items.description: Either partner with permitted lodging OR pursue County permits for accommodations + TAT filings

categories.title: Structures & Building
categories.description: Keep all structures legal or exempt under Agricultural District rules

items.title: Use only permitted or exempt accessory structures
items.description: Non-habitable structures ≤600 sq ft on Agricultural land

items.title: NO permanent sleeping or plumbing in exempt structures
items.description: Exempt sheds/yurts must remain non-habitable

items.title: File Ag-exempt declaration with County if required
items.description: Keep acknowledgment in compliance binder

items.title: Obtain Fire Dept permit for tents >700 sq ft
items.description: Required for any temporary structures exceeding size limit

items.title: Obtain Assembly permit for occupancy ≥300 people
items.description: Required when assembly load reaches 300 or more persons

categories.title: Health, Food & Sanitation
categories.description: DOH compliance for food service and sanitation facilities

items.title: Obtain DOH Special Event Food Establishment permit OR use licensed caterer
items.description: Required for any food preparation or service activities

items.title: Provide portable toilets and hand-wash stations
items.description: Required sanitation facilities with service documentation

items.title: Keep portable toilet service receipts
items.description: Document compliance with sanitation service contracts

items.title: Document health compliance in binder
items.description: Maintain all health and sanitation permits and receipts

categories.title: Make the Event Private
categories.description: Establish and maintain private membership association structure

items.title: Implement membership application → approval → signed agreement process
items.description: Formal process to establish private membership status

items.title: Update website: 'Private, members-only; application/invitation only'
items.description: Clear messaging about private nature of events

items.title: Eliminate all public ticket sales
items.description: No Eventbrite, public listings, or open sales channels

items.title: Install gate signage: 'Private Event — Members & Invited Guests Only'
items.description: Clear on-site indication of private event status

items.title: Maintain member roster on site
items.description: Current list of approved members and guests available during events

categories.title: Neighbor & Nuisance Controls
categories.description: Community relations and impact mitigation measures

items.title: Set headcount cap tied to parking capacity
items.description: Limit attendance based on available on-site parking spaces

items.title: Implement noise plan and curfew (quiet hours)
items.description: Establish and enforce quiet hours to minimize neighbor impact

items.title: Require on-site parking only with cones/attendant
items.description: No street parking or off-site overflow parking

items.title: Post neighbor contact phone at entrance
items.description: Provide direct contact method for neighbor concerns

items.title: Document neighbor contact responses
items.description: Keep records of any neighbor communications or concerns

categories.title: Compliance Binder
categories.description: Required documentation to maintain at every event

items.title: TMK zoning printout + Code Ch.25 excerpts
items.description: Current zoning verification and relevant code sections

items.title: EPIC/Building docs + ag-exempt declarations
items.description: All building permits and agricultural exemption documentation

items.title: Tent/Fire permits, food permits, portable toilet contract
items.description: All current permits and service contracts

items.title: Insurance certificates (general liability + participant accident)
items.description: Current insurance coverage documentation

items.title: Member roster + signed agreements + safety briefing sheet
items.description: All member-related documentation and safety protocols

items.title: Incident log
items.description: Record of any incidents, concerns, or safety issues

items.title: Collect and remit GET on dues/fees
items.description: General Excise Tax compliance for all revenue

items.title: Apply TAT (10.25%) + County 3% for overnight consideration
items.description: Transient Accommodations Tax if any overnight stays are provided

items.title: File TA-1/TA-2 + County portal submissions
items.description: Required state and county TAT filings if applicable

items.title: Keep PMA books separate from LLC
items.description: Maintain distinct financial records for different entities

categories.title: Risk Management (Tripwires)
categories.description: Automatic pause triggers to prevent compliance violations

items.title: NEVER add sleeping/plumbing to exempt structure
items.description: Automatic pause trigger - would require building permits

items.title: NEVER use tents >700 sq ft without Fire permit
items.description: Automatic pause trigger - requires Fire Department approval

items.title: NEVER advertise public tickets
items.description: Automatic pause trigger - would violate private event status

items.title: NEVER scale headcount beyond safe parking/noise capacity
items.description: Automatic pause trigger - would create neighbor and safety issues

items.title: ANY neighbor complaint or inspector visit → pause + remediate
items.description: Immediate response protocol for external concerns

categories.title: Investor Reassurance
categories.description: Four-front compliance strategy for stakeholder confidence

items.title: Private, invitation-only educational day-use retreats under PMA
items.description: Front 1: Establish clear private membership structure

items.title: Only permitted or exempt non-habitable Ag structures
items.description: Front 2: Maintain building code compliance with proper permits

items.title: DOH food & sanitation support (toilets, handwash, caterers)
items.description: Front 3: Professional health and safety compliance

items.title: Compliance binder + neighbor-friendly operating plan
items.description: Front 4: Documentation and community relations strategy

items.title: Maintain alignment with County zoning/building rules
items.description: Ongoing compliance with local regulations

items.title: Avoid triggers that bring inspectors
items.description: Proactive risk management to prevent enforcement actions

items.title: Plan long-term permitted overnight options
items.description: Strategic planning for future expansion with proper permits
